name: Panel From Outline
description: Creates a Panel from a polyline outline and thickness.

inputParameters.name: outline
inputParameters.description: Polyline outline of the panel (top face).

inputParameters.name: vector
inputParameters.description: (optional) Direction vector for the thickness. If not provided, derived from the outline normal.

inputParameters.name: features
inputParameters.description: (Optional) Panel feature definitions, including openings, from the Panel Opening, MEP Penetration, Niche or Linear Service components. Definitions that do not lie on this panel are skipped, so the same list can go to every panel.

inputParameters.name: updateRefObj
inputParameters.description: (optional) If True, attributes in the referenced object will be updated.
